requirements.statement: /ship-build and /ship-setup end with the four-section readout and a COMMAND COMPLETE or COMMAND STUCK banner as the last line
No turn claims later work (a resume, a trigger, a CI result, a notification) without the primitive that backs it in the same turn; a CI wait uses a bounded primitive
/ship-build runs autonomously from invocation to banner; asks the owner only in autonomy.md's four cases. /ship-setup is interactive by purpose
Ensemble never assumes Forge exists
The chain-of-custody check is deterministic and unit-tested
Template scaffolded to .claude/rules/ship.md with no active ship step; default string first among its examples; example run lines for release and platform steps
Ordered steps with parameters, in ship and after-shipping parts, with a bounded repeat
close-issue and file-followups after shipping, in the default, each left out to switch it off
Round count on repeat (default 2), bar on collect-findings, below-bar filing on file-followups
ship.md owner-governed; changes only via /ship-setup
/ship-setup interviews, offers default string, round count 2 and significance bar, records a release command where verification.md has none, writes ship.md
Running /ship-setup is the approval; no re-confirmation; never run means only a push
/ship-build resolves the current work the way /implement-trd does
The sequencer hands out steps in order, each after the previous succeeded; wait parks, stop sticks
Shipped = last ship step succeeded; then after-shipping steps and shipped.json; closed is not shipped
Readout, then COMPLETE or STUCK last; COMPLETE is not shipped
No ship.md or no ship step: commit, push, no PR, point to /ship-setup; name a PR already open
Full PRD-to-TRD feature needs closed.json; /plan and /sweep do not
Primitive set present; old stages map onto it
Default and five owner strings parse and run end to end (release with an identity command)
open-pr opens against ship.md's base whatever the setting; reuses an open PR
merge, release, run and other outward primitives only when listed; listing authorizes; pull-request.js still never merges
Release command from verification.md, else ship.md; with neither, stop
push commits a sweep by pathspec
Code fixes via discovered.record plus --reconcile --chained; no direct edits; implement-trd.md admits /ship-build
Triage table followed; lint means tool run
Ownership judge; out-of-scope failures filed, not fixed
Re-verify only criteria whose covered files changed; never re-audit
Significance bar; reviewer labels used when present
repeat rounds=N makes at most N fix rounds (default 2), then one final pass; critical stops (STUCK, PR left); below-critical recorded and filed
Any wait ends run COMPLETE with a resumable record; readout says not shipped, NEXT --resume
--resume runs remaining steps
Close only after the last ship step, in the declared tracker
Close the issue the PRD/TRD header or branch names; none means close nothing and say so
All sources filed, only this work's and this ship's; old sweep-ledger rows untouched
Below-bar not filed unless opted in, AC-F9.7's record included
Filed issue links back; at most once, stable id
Unfiled listed in readout; below-bar review findings named with the record's path
implement-trd Step 7.2 records every review finding it did not fix
stack.md template declares tracker
Close and file use the declared tracker
No tracker: nothing filed or closed; readout lists it
/audit-build names /ship-build, never runs it; PR opening unchanged
constitution.md amendment drafted
autonomy.md amendment drafted: listed outward steps authorized, /ship-setup interactive, PR exception kept
Neither constitution.md nor autonomy.md changed before approval
Anchor: audited commit, else the pushed commit
Code equal = no tree difference outside .trd-state/, the audit report, the TRD, test-only files
Push, merge and deploy links each compare with the anchor
Full commit id written; unique short id resolves, ambiguous fails
Changes to shipped source re-verified, then anchor moves; each move recorded by the custody check alone
Any other difference stops the run naming step and files; never auto-fixed
Deterministic lib with unit tests, outside pull-request.js
A PR trigger resumes remaining steps
Trigger claimed only when set
The owner's primitives exist; push and the design sync settled by the TRD
Each primitive states input, result and waiting state with its bounded primitive
The project's string runs under deterministic code
Iteration is one generic bounded repeat
Default string is the template's first example and /ship-setup's default; strings with an approval step or no outside reviewer run on the same code
Primitive or sequencer, never both; a new primitive needs no sequencer change
/sync-design runs unasked after merge, via a deterministic check with no Forge assumption
Last line of every final turn is a COMPLETE or STUCK banner, preceded by the readout (verifies NFR-1)
No unbacked resume, trigger, CI or notification claim (verifies NFR-2)
/ship-build asks only in the four cases; /ship-setup interviews (verifies NFR-3)
No Forge call or assumption in either command (verifies NFR-4)
Unit tests cover each link (push, merge, deploy), the ignored-path classification, each way the anchor moves, and each failure condition (verifies NFR-5)

open_questions: OQ-1 | How does a `/sweep` get a code fix while shipping, with no TRD to reconcile? | OWNER-CALL (scope) | As D15: for sweep work fix-findings returns stop, naming /plan <the findings> then /ship-build --resume. No --chained mode added to /plan.
OQ-2 | Is a must-pass criterion with no covered-file record affected by a change? | default | Yes, whenever any shipped source changed (D12).

OQ-3 | Examples 4 and 5 list a release with no identity command, but AC-F14.3 fails a release that reports none | answered | The deploy link stays strict; examples 4 and 5 carry the default string's identity= placeholder and run once it is filled.

OQ-4 | Is there an overall time limit on CI and review waits? | OWNER-CALL (risk appetite) | No overall limit written. wait-ci re-arms its 30-minute Monitor only while a check is pending; request-review arms once and an arm ending with no review returns wait (run parks).
OQ-5 | Which reviewer labels are critical or above the bar? | default | D17's mapping; any label it does not list goes to the judge (D16).
OQ-6 | Which /task follow-ups does a ship file? | answered | Every one not yet marked in its task's ledger, from any /task (D26).
OQ-7 | (no row in table) | closed earlier, answered in TRD 1.1.0
OQ-8 | (no row in table) | dissolved in 2.0.0: no ci-green; fixing happens only where a string lists fix-findings
OQ-9 | What sets a trigger on the PR (F17)? | default | A GitHub Actions workflow on an approving review (D35), installed only on the owner's yes.

OQ-10 | Does a Skill-forked /code-review's completion reach the session with each finding and whether it was applied? | default | Assume it does; if not, the unresolved [review-pending] row is reported as a gap (D25).
OQ-11 | Do test helpers and fixtures outside __tests__/__fixtures__/__mocks__ count as test-only? | default | No (D10).
OQ-12 | Does a failed audit gate end COMPLETE or STUCK? | answered | STUCK (D37).
OQ-13 | Where does the final state directory land after a merge? | answered | Uncommitted after a merge; NEXT says to commit it on the default branch (D38).
OQ-14 | Default merge method? | answered | merge (D3).

OQ-15 | Does the first sweep ship file every open row already in .trd-state/_sweep/discovered.jsonl, including old sweeps'? | OWNER-CALL (scope), decided by product PM on owner's behalf 2026-11-07, pending owner review | No: a ship files only the follow-ups of the work it ships and those it found itself (D26, D39).
OQ-16 | Should fix-findings wait for the chained build's Step 7.2 review before the next push? | answered | No; late review edits stay uncommitted and are named in ISSUES (D14, §3.7).
OQ-17 | A work naming two issues: close both, or neither? | answered | Neither, and name them (D29).
OQ-18 | Retarget a PR /audit-build opened against another base, or stop? | default | Retarget (D22), reported as retargeted from <old>.

OQ-19 | The owner defined 'merged' as 'the audited commit is an ancestor of the default branch'; after a squash or rebase merge it never is | OWNER-CALL (two readings) | Keep --merged-head (D43): also accept an ancestor of a PR head the caller has proven merged.
OQ-20 | Should the sync-design primitive start a build to capture against? | OWNER-CALL (scope) | No: it runs verification.md §2's fast refresh for local when declared and nothing more (D43, §3.9).

OQ-21 | What is J-7's 'check on main' for merges made outside /ship-build? | OWNER-CALL (scope; touches credentials) | The design-map.js unsynced --merged-into command, run by Forge's merge step or the owner's own automation; Ensemble ships no CI job for it.

OQ-22 | Should the default string ship active in every project's ship.md? | OWNER-CALL (two readings) | No: keep D44. The template ships with an empty ## Ship; the default string is its first example, labelled as the default, and /ship-setup's default answer. Pending owner review (PRD 2.2.1 §8, AC-F1.1).
OQ-23 | What is 'another Claude Code session' as a reviewer? | default | A headless claude -p "/code-review <pr-url> --comment" started by request-review tool=claude (§3.2).
OQ-24 | How does the post-merge sync's commit reach the default branch? | answered | On its own design-sync/<feature> branch and PR (D43).
